title: "Data Overview"

## Available datasets

The workspace includes several CSV files related to vaccination records and surveys:

- `covid_daily_survey.csv`
- `covid_dose_history.csv`
- `covid_enrollment.csv`
- `covid_vaccination.csv`
- `covid_vaccination_old_records.csv`
- `covid_weekly_survey.csv`

## Example analysis ideas

- Compare enrollment counts over time.
- Review dose history patterns by participant.
- Connect weekly survey responses to vaccine status.

## Notes

This page is intentionally lightweight so you can extend it into a full dashboard with visual summaries and narrative analysis.
